en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European spa town with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings on a steep cobbled street. On the left is a building marked "PHARMACIE." In the center distance stands a circular colonnaded pavilion with a domed roof, while to the right is a tall tower with a bulbous Baroque-style spire. In the lower right corner are long, richly decorated wooden colonnades along a promenade, with people walking and horse-drawn carriages on the street. The scene is set in a narrow valley with wooded hills rising behind the town.
